headline: Sparkelf Build
title: Sparkelf Build | The Fire Boost Support | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Sparkelf is a Fire support with a team heal and Fire boosts. Its trait, Reliable Fire Companion, raises the party's Fire Elemental Boost. Use Spark Energy as the lead skill, a fireball that costs twenty energy. Its ultimate, Keep the Fire Bolt Going, hits for ninety power and boosts nearby allies' Fire damage. It is weak to Water and Earth, so cover those. Pair it with Fire teammates. Do you run Sparkelf? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Sparkelf build: lead with Spark Energy, finish with Keep the Fire Bolt Going and use the Reliable Fire Companion trait to boost the party's Fire damage. Weak to Water and Earth.
